results.fact: trailhead-to-high-camp distance (dist_km 4 mi vs itinerary day 1 5.7 mi vs camp waypoint distMi 3.2)
results.evidence: Three different figures describe the same Eldorado trailhead-to-Inspiration-Glacier-camp leg on this row (and its siblings): waypoint distMi 3.2 (shorter than the ~3.7 mi straight line between the two pins), dist_km ≈ 4 mi, and itinerary day 1 5.7 mi. WTA gives Eldorado Peak as 10 mi round trip (≈5 mi one-way to a summit above camp), which suggests camp is ~4-4.5 mi, but no second source states the camp distance, so nothing was changed.

Mountain Project lists the route as ~800 ft (242 m), matching length_m 244. Parties describe 'short-pitch after short-pitch' and the Alpine Institute lists one pitch off the col, several ropelengths on the ridge, two rappels, two good pitches and one or two easy ones, so many short pitches over 800 ft is plausible; no field gives a conflicting pitch count (pitch_detail groups rather than counts).

The 8-12 hours camp-summit-camp figure is confirmed by the Alpine Institute route profile and the Mountain Project description. descentTimeHrs 6 matches the sibling Dorado rows' 'Hike out' section (camp back to the trailhead, 5-5.5 h), i.e. the day-3 exit, not the summit-to-camp descent, so the two do not overlap. No source gives a separate summit-to-camp time to justify changing it.
